paras: NB: I am NOT saying use these. However, many people attempt to do things for the first time such as self hypnosis, contact with their inner child, contact with their Higher Self etc when they are in a mind altered state.
If you do use them, be aware you don't want to force a revelation out of the state but instead use it to help you do things in your regular life.

If you have had an opening in the past, the key is to recognize that it is different to have an experience, access it in a particular state and access it in your day to day life. It is great that it has opened but if the child can't take it in, then

Use phrases such as; Help me to ground. Help me to only take that which I can take in. Help me to remember love. Help me to come back when the time is right. Help me to take one change into my regular life.
You should NOT use self hypnosis to; Keep you in that state forever Get memories to come up Make yourself afraid to do things Not sleep Override things that your body needs Not talk to people

If you are doing this in an altered state of consciousness and it is helping you not to love, not to ground, not to be honest, not to sleep, not to communicate, not to do regular life things, you need to STOP trying to go deeper and work on integrating what you have.

Self hypnosis can be extremely powerful when you are in a different state of consciousness (such as on loveyhuasca, meditating, in a lucid dream, when you are grieving, when you are using sexual energy, when you are praying, when you are not sleeping, or with other plant medicines etc). Sometimes you can open your mind up faster than you can process it as an adult.

The problem comes in when people are in a different state of consciousness, they think it must mean something. Sometimes it is your inner child, sometimes it is a Protector projecting their fear, sometimes it is your shame/grief/anger/longing etc coming up for help, but sometimes it is just your body's way of saying it doesn't like what is happening, the environment is chaotic, you didn't sleep well, or for any number of other reasons it might not make sense. Just because you get a picture that scares you, it might not be true. Just because you have a bad feeling, it doesn't mean it is a lesson. Just because you get a download in nice lighting, that doesn't mean you should believe it.
Instead of trying to interpret what is going on, ask yourself;
